WITH store_sales_data AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity,
           avg(ss_ext_tax) as ext_avg,
           avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) as net_avg
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND count(*) > 1071
)
SELECT case 
    when (ss_quantity between 1 and 20) then (select ext_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) 
    else (select net_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) end bucket1,
   case 
    when (ss_quantity between 21 and 40) then (select ext_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) 
    else (select net_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) end bucket2,
   case 
    when (ss_quantity between 41 and 60) then (select ext_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) 
    else (select net_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) end bucket3,
   case 
    when (ss_quantity between 61 and 80) then (select ext_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) 
    else (select net_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) end bucket4,
   case 
    when (ss_quantity between 81 and 100) then (select ext_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) 
    else (select net_avg from store_sales_data where ss_quantity = ss_quantity) end bucket5
FROM reason
where r_reason_sk = 1
